name: DOGE late spot-confirmed favourite
description: Buys the DOGE favourite (YES or NO) once per market with 4-6 minutes left, only when spot is at least 1.5 sigma (15-min realized vol) past the strike; held to settlement. sol-zfav's rule unchanged.
hypothesis: Rule fixed in advance (sol-zfav, zmin 1.5, tau 360/300/240, max 97c), moved unchanged to DOGE. Dev screen (taker prints, fee included, Mar-Aug): +1.95c over 3,297 trades, positive in 6/6 months, May-Aug +0.6..+1.8c. Other side: flat-vol quoters and favourite sellers who exit early. Wrong if CI<0, <60% months positive, 2x latency negative, or decay to ~0 like SOL in Jul-Aug.
